[Scoped at Review 63 (B1648, 2026-10-14): 'the only lifts that agree with the ruled moves' rests on the Delta^4 check alone, coherence over Aut+(F2) being the Banking Seat's Gate 12 (P-074), still owed; 'the two objects are one' takes the weave's surface to be M_{1,2}, the SM seat's reading (W19, verified in part, B1624)] [Audited by main (P-152, B1655, 2026-10-15): 'exactly the golden pattern' is the support (zero diagonal) only: the symmetric c and the antisymmetric epsilon both obey the parity rule, and B1642 shows the zero modes give epsilon] 0 of 19.
